dedupe_keys.name: xi an medium deep borehole short term thermal storage model outputs

description: This Zenodo release supplies boundary conditions, fluid inlet and outlet temperatures, soil and circulation-fluid temperature distributions, heat extraction and storage capacity, and efficiency calculations for a medium-deep borehole heat-exchanger strategy. The Data in Brief article says the model uses a real engineering project in Xi’an, China, to compare short-term charging and discharge during the heating season with intermittent and long-term storage. The accessible earlier version 19157841 lists five spreadsheets and a case ZIP under CC BY 4.0. The article-cited later version 19564997 is currently embargoed with no public files; both share Zenodo concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.17345839. This is project-based model output and input, not direct measurement of a regional heating network. Local geological parameters, simulated strategy choices and unknown differences between versions are limitations. A reviewer-assessed use is checking borehole storage assumptions or thermal response in district-heat planning. model-tuw-geophires-interactive-geothermal-simulator is a related geothermal model, but no import was tested. No file was downloaded.
